name: Central semi-arid field

irrigation.basis: In November normal evaporation is ~39 mm per week and it rains ~17 mm (NASA POWER). The shortfall is replaced for a producing garden (Kc 1); 1 mm = 1 liter per m².

evidence: Catalog: Bean can be sown in November (INTA Pro-Huerta garden calendar).
Catalog: Zucchini can be sown in November (INTA Pro-Huerta garden calendar).

tips: Frost usually ends around Sep 12 (NASA POWER): after that date the risk drops for cold-sensitive plants.
Water demand is high: drip irrigation delivers water at the root and mulching reduces evaporation (INTA Pro-Huerta).
Rotate crop families between beds each season (leaves, fruits, roots, legumes) to care for the soil.
